title: decide tour: a new home screen for a task app

goal.note: Due dates are what people open the app for.

migration.other: Keep creation date, fill the rest later

digest:
1. [goal] What matters most in the first version of the home screen? → People see what's due ★
   ✎ Due dates are what people open the app for.
2. [layout] Which home screen layout do we go with? → Board by status (against the recommendation: Today view)
3. [card] This is the task card. Do we approve it? → Yes, go with it ★
4. [features] What else goes into the first version? → Reminders, Shared lists
5. [order] In what order do we build it? → The today view > New task cards > Reminders > Animations
6. [confidence] How sure are you that people plan by day rather than by project? → 4/5
7. [rollout] How do we roll it out? → 🤝 up to the agent
8. [share] What share of users do we start with? → ⏭ skipped
9. [migration] What do we do with old tasks that have no due date? → own option: "Keep creation date, fill the rest later"
10. [name] What do we call the new screen in the app? → "Dues"
Comment: Looks good overall.
